Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<algorithm>
#include<vector>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    string licenseKeyFormatting(string s, int k) {
        // 1.删除所有的-
        string newStr = "";
        for (auto ch : s)
        {
            if (ch != '-') 
            {
                if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') newStr.push_back(ch + 'A' - 'a');
                else newStr.push_back(ch);
            }
        }

        int len = newStr.size();
        // 2.从末尾开始loop, 每走k格加一个-
        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            int gap = len - 1 - i;
            if (gap > 0 && (gap % k == 0))
            {
                newStr.insert(newStr.begin() + i + 1, '-');
            }            
        }
        
        return newStr;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    string str = "5F3Z-2e-9-w";
    int k = 4;
    auto res = sol.licenseKeyFormatting(str, k);
    cout << res << endl;    

    return 0;
}
